method: Compared the lesson with official OpenAI model selection and Anthropic model selection, cost-intelligence and pricing documentation; ran 36 offline checks and executed both lesson Python examples with a mocked SDK. No provider request or model-quality benchmark was run.

observations.trace: The cost example produced the declared 2,190-token / 1,095,000-token synthetic scenario for 75 base input, 32 growth, 10 turns and 500 conversations. Router rules selected configured tiers; valid mock labels were accepted; exceptions, truncation and invalid labels returned manual_review_required. No provider calls occurred.

limitations: No model/provider request, candidate-quality benchmark, production billing comparison, or approval workflow was tested.
Historical 2026-09-24 usage and request/response snapshots are incomplete; only arithmetic over the preserved input column is shown.
Route cost scenarios use constructed assumptions and cannot predict production savings.
